metadata.scenario: A customer seeks clarification on a billing discrepancy related to a service they did not use. Category: Billing. Flags: billing_dispute.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I assist you today? Hi Margaret, this is Charles Thompson. I'm calling about a billing issue I've noticed. Hi Charles! I hope you’re doing well. What seems to be the issue with your bill? Well, I was charged for a service I didn't use last week. There’s a charge for physical therapy, but I didn’t have a session. I understand. Let me pull up your account and take a look at the details. One moment, please. Sure, take your time. I just want to clarify why I was billed for that. Alright, I see here that there was a scheduled physical therapy session for last Wednesday, but it looks like it was canceled the day before. Yes, I remember canceling it, but I wasn't expecting a charge since I didn’t use the service. That’s understandable, Charles. It looks like there was a misunderstanding in our billing system. So, what can be done about this charge? I can request a review of the charge and potentially issue a refund. I’ll need to document your dispute formally. That sounds good. What else do you need from me? Just your confirmation that you want to dispute the charge, and I’ll take care of the rest. Yes, please dispute it, I didn’t use that service. Got it. I’ll submit that right away. It may take a few business days to process. I appreciate it. Is there anything else you need from me? Just your feedback on our services. By the way, we offer additional personal care assistance if you might be interested. Oh, I didn’t know that. What does it include? Personal care assistance includes help with bathing, grooming, and companionship. It’s $28 to $35 per hour. That sounds helpful. I might consider that in the future. Great! If you're interested, I can connect you with our Care Coordinator, Lisa, to discuss more. Yes, please do that. I’d like to learn more about it. I will inform Lisa, and she’ll reach out to you. Is there anything else I can help you with today? No, that’s everything. Thanks for your help, Margaret. You’re welcome, Charles! Thank you for calling, and have a great day! You too, bye!
